keyPoints: Samrup (similar) aakaar aakaar me same, naap me chhote-bade hote hain — kon barabar, bhujaen ek hi anupat me — naap alag ho sakti hai, aakaar nahi.
AAA: teenon kon barabar to tribhuj samrup; vyavahar me AA hi kaafi hai — do kon barabar to teesra khud barabar ho jaata hai.
SSS samrupta: teenon bhujaen ek hi anupat me hon; SAS: do bhujaen anupat me aur beech ka kon barabar ho.
Samrup tribhujon ke kshetrafalon ka anupat = sangat bhujaon ke anupat ka varg — bhuja dugni to kshetrafal chauguna.
Thales prameya: tribhuj ki ek bhuja ke samantar rekha doosri do bhujaon ko samanupat me baantti hai — aur iska vilom bhi satya hai.
Pythagoras prameya: samkon tribhuj me karn² = lamb² + aadhar² — samrupta se siddh hota hai, 3-4-5 yaad rakho.
Aam galti: sarvangsam aur samrup ko ek samajhna — sarvangsam me bhujaen barabar, samrup me sirf anupat barabar.
